orthogonal_to: V3 soft utility blend of risk+opportunity
mechanism: Hard gate: refuse trade if predicted future-unsellable or liquidity-collapse exceeds frozen thresholds; only survivors are ranked by opportunity head. Risk is a veto, not a soft penalty.

orthogonal_to: V3 training on mixed PROXY_PATH + unaudited rows
mechanism: Restrict modeling and selection to rows with PIT-audited buy SUCCESS and current sell SUCCESS at decision block; drop proxy labels. Tests whether execution-clean sub-universe carries edge.

orthogonal_to: V3 pooled model across lifecycle buckets
mechanism: Fit separate dual-head models inside each formal age bucket; no cross-bucket parameter sharing. Edge may be bucket-local.

orthogonal_to: V3 entry-score focus with fixed 6h horizon wallet label
mechanism: Select on high p(TP-before-SL) and short predicted time_to_right_tail; prefer quick right-tail capture over terminal 6h return.

orthogonal_to: V3 top-k=2 dense selection without deployer weekly cap
mechanism: Ultra-sparse policy: select only utility >= train q90, at most 1 per decision_time, and at most 1 fill per deployer per calendar week to force breadth.

orthogonal_to: V3 treating 15-60m only as unused negative control
mechanism: Train a fatal/avoid classifier on 15-60m negative-control rows only; apply as PIT veto on formal buckets (transfer of avoid signature, not of V3 alpha scores).
